blocks.text: WAREHOUSE CLEANOUT FAQ
Warehouse Cleanout Services in Pickering — FAQs

items.q: What are included in warehouse cleanout services in Pickering?
a: Warehouse cleanouts can include unwanted pallets, packaging, shelving, storage units, inventory, furniture, electronics, accepted equipment and general non-hazardous commercial junk.

items.q: We're relocating rather than closing. Do your warehouse cleanout services cover both buildings?
a: Yes, and it is how we prefer to handle a move. What is going to the new site gets identified, protected and moved; everything else is cleared. One quote covers both halves rather than a haulage bill from one contractor and a disposal bill from another.

items.q: Our racking won't fit the bay spacing in the new building. What happens to it?
a: It comes out and, if it is a recognised make in reasonable condition, goes to a resale buyer rather than scrap — which reduces what the warehouse cleanout costs you. If there is no buyer it is weighed out as scrap steel and recycled. We tell you which when we quote.

items.q: Can unwanted inventory be included in a warehouse cleanout?
a: Yes. Excess, outdated or unwanted commercial inventory can be removed when it falls within our accepted service scope.

items.q: Can I include my warehouse office in the cleanout?
a: Yes. Attached offices and staff areas can be included when they form part of the agreed project.
